idea: Research process audit and redesign for boutique asset managers
buyer: CIOs and heads of research at 10-60 person firms
pain: Research workflow is inherited, inefficient, and nobody has re-examined it
v1: Two-week diagnostic and a redesign memo
channel: Direct to her network plus husband's hedge fund contacts
verdict: Her single most distinctive offer: the finance-plus-AI-change-management combination almost nobody else holds.

why.distribution: 20-50 warm firms across her network and her husband's, and the buyer is a person she can name.
why.demand: Firms are actively spending on AI transformation, but no one has been quoted this price yet.
why.fmf: Exactly the remit she held: redesigning research workflow around AI for sceptical professionals.
why.revenue_structure: One-off engagements; a follow-on implementation retainer is possible but not contracted.
why.defensibility: Reputation and method; consultancies will move into this, though few have her credibility.
why.leverage: Custom consulting with a reusable diagnostic; her presence is required throughout.
why.time_to_revenue: A warm intro to a scoped engagement in 1-3 months.
why.tailwind: The strongest budgeted trend she can access - AI adoption spend in professional services.
why.ceiling: £20k x 10 engagements = £200k, but 10 engagements is close to full-time delivery.

ceiling_arithmetic: £20k x 10 engagements = £200k gross with negligible direct cost - clears the bar exactly. But each is 2-3 weeks of her time, so 10 engagements plus selling is a full year. Part-time realistic: 4-5 = £80-100k.
carries: The rarest combination she owns, a buyer with live budget, and a price point that reaches the target with only ten sales.
kills: Leverage. It is consulting, so the ceiling and her calendar are the same thing.
test: Pitch a £15k two-week diagnostic to three firms in her network.
test_fail: They want a free workshop first, or already have a Big Four engagement.
